A bar of the Hitachino Nest brewery from Ibaraki, inside the SEEKBASE complex. Tonkatsu is on the menu too.
A beer bar in the basement (B1F). Fridays it stays open until midnight.
A beer bar that also serves Indian curry, with a lunch slot and an evening slot. A small seating charge is added in the evening.
A beer hall and dining bar on the restaurant floor of Yodobashi Akiba. It opens at 11:00, so it works for an early drink.
A beer hall of the Yona Yona Ale brewer, with Spanish-bar style food. On weekends it opens at 11:30.
A big craft beer bar with standing, counter and table seats, 110 seats in all. Open every day from 13:00.
A liquor shop with a standing bar. Weekday evenings only, and there is no seating charge.
A sake bar and izakaya on the 2nd floor, right by the station.
A small craft beer bar with a mostly standing counter. It opens at 16:00 on weekdays.
A standing bar with grilled chicken skewers. Close to the ticket gates, so it is an easy first stop.
Another standing bar with grilled skewers, a short walk from the station.
Bar Malt Road is closed on Sundays, public holidays and the third Monday. Fujita Saketen is open on weekdays only, from 17:00 to 21:00.
